title: Case 03: Lauria Bible and Ashley Freeman | Update

sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，人们在加州的一处葡萄园里发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首了，体内血液也已被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来隐瞒她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 直到后来，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列节目，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: On the 29th of January 1999, best friends Laura Bible and Ashley Freeman had a sleepover at Ashley's house to celebrate her 16th birthday.
sentences.zh: 1999年1月29日，好朋友劳拉·拜布尔和阿什利·弗里曼在阿什利家过夜，庆祝她的16岁生日。

sentences.en: Ashley's parents, Danny and Kathy Freeman, were also at the house, located in Craig County, Oklahoma.
sentences.zh: 阿什利的父母丹尼和凯茜·弗里曼也在位于俄克拉荷马州克雷格县的家中。

sentences.en: About 6am the next morning, a neighbour reported that the Freeman house was on fire.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上6点左右，一位邻居报警称弗里曼家着火了。

sentences.en: Emergency services rushed to the scene and found the bodies of Kathy and Danny Freeman.
sentences.zh: 紧急救援人员赶到现场，发现了凯茜和丹尼·弗里曼的遗体。

sentences.en: However, Laura and Ashley were nowhere to be found.
sentences.zh: 然而，劳拉和阿什利却不见踪影。

sentences.en: We covered this story very early on, way back in Case 3.
sentences.zh: 我们在很久以前就报道过这个故事，远在第3案时。

sentences.en: All sorts of theories have emerged over the years.
sentences.zh: 多年来，各种各样的理论层出不穷。

sentences.en: There was speculation Ashley and Laura might have murdered Danny and Kathy themselves.
sentences.zh: 曾有猜测认为，阿什利和劳拉可能亲手谋杀了丹尼和凯茜。

sentences.en: There were rumours that Danny was involved in drugs.
sentences.zh: 还有传言称丹尼涉嫌毒品交易。

sentences.en: Two different convicted murderers confessed to killing Laura and Ashley, only to later recant their confessions.
sentences.zh: 两名不同的已定罪杀人犯曾承认杀害了劳拉和阿什利，但后来又翻供了。

sentences.en: The case has remained unsolved for all of these years.
sentences.zh: 这起案件这么多年来一直未破。

sentences.en: Until now.
sentences.zh: 直到现在。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: I'm Craig County District Attorney Matt Ballard.
sentences.zh: 我是克雷格县地方检察官马特·巴拉德。

sentences.en: For 18 years, the community in Craig County, including many members of the media, have followed the case of the deaths of Danny and Kathy Freeman,
sentences.zh: 18年来，克雷格县的民众，包括许多媒体成员，一直关注着丹尼和凯茜·弗里曼夫妇死亡的案件，

sentences.en: the mysterious disappearance of their 16-year-old daughter, Ashley Freeman, and Ashley's friend, 16-year-old Laura Bible, and the arson of the Freeman family home.
sentences.zh: 他们16岁的女儿阿什利·弗里曼以及阿什利的朋友、16岁的劳拉·拜布尔的神秘失踪案，还有弗里曼家族住宅的纵火案。

sentences.en: Yesterday, there was an arrest in the case.
sentences.zh: 昨天，此案有了逮捕行动。

sentences.en: OSBI investigator Tammy Ferrari and my SVU investigator Gary Stancil, through incredible police work, identified three perpetrators,
sentences.zh: 俄克拉荷马州调查局（OSBI）调查员塔米·法拉利和我的性侵及虐童案调查员加里·斯坦西尔通过出色的警务工作，确定了三名犯罪嫌疑人，

sentences.en: two of whom have since died since the beginning of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 其中两人自调查开始以来已经去世。

sentences.en: Today, charges were filed against Ronnie Dean Busick, who by law is presumed innocent of the charges.
sentences.zh: 今天，罗尼·迪恩·布西克被正式起诉，依法他被推定为无罪。

sentences.en: Mr. Busick is charged with acting in concert with two other men as follows.
sentences.zh: 布西克先生被指控与另外两名男子共同实施了以下罪行。

sentences.en: Four counts of first-degree murder for killing Kathy Freeman, Danny Freeman, Ashley Freeman, and Laura Bible.
sentences.zh: 四项一级谋杀罪，分别杀害了凯茜·弗里曼、丹尼·弗里曼、阿什利·弗里曼和劳拉·拜布尔。

sentences.en: Two counts of kidnapping for the abductions of Ashley Freeman and Laura Bible, and a final count of first-degree arson for setting fire to the Freeman home.
sentences.zh: 两项绑架罪，绑架了阿什利·弗里曼和劳拉·拜布尔，以及最后一项一级纵火罪，即放火烧毁弗里曼的家。

sentences.en: The other two perpetrators identified during the most recent course of the investigation are Warren Philip Welch II, more commonly known as Phil Welch, and David A.
sentences.zh: 在最近的调查过程中确定的另外两名犯罪嫌疑人是沃伦·菲利普·韦尔奇二世（通常被称为菲尔·韦尔奇）和大卫·A·

sentences.en: Pennington.
sentences.zh: 彭宁顿。

sentences.en: Again, Mr. Welch and Mr. Pennington died during the course of this investigation.
sentences.zh: 再次说明，韦尔奇先生和彭宁顿先生在此次调查过程中已经去世。

sentences.en: Members of Ashley and Laura's families were briefed this morning regarding the arrest, charges, and details brought to light by investigators Ferrari and Stancil.
sentences.zh: 今天上午，调查员法拉利和斯坦西尔向阿什利和劳拉的家属通报了有关逮捕、指控以及曝光的细节。

sentences.en: Here again, I want to extend my condolences to the girls' families.
sentences.zh: 在此，我再次向女孩们的家属表示慰问。

sentences.en: They've learned these young ladies' final days were certainly horrific, and today's announcement no doubt comes as little solace to their grief.
sentences.zh: 他们得知这两个年轻女孩生命的最后几天无疑是极其可怕的，今天的宣布对他们的悲痛来说无疑是杯水车薪。

sentences.en: We're standing together, releasing this statement, however,
sentences.zh: 然而，我们今天站在一起发表这项声明，

sentences.en: because we believe there are people with knowledge of this crime who can assist in recovering the girls' bodies and bring some closure to the families.
sentences.zh: 是因为我们相信有人知道这起犯罪的信息，能够协助找回女孩们的遗体，并给家属们一些心灵的慰藉。

sentences.en: As set forth in the affidavit for arrest warrant, Phil Welch, Dave Pennington, and Ronnie Busick killed Mr. and Mrs. Freeman, abducted the teenage girls,
sentences.zh: 正如逮捕令宣誓书中所述，菲尔·韦尔奇、戴夫·彭宁顿和罗尼·布西克杀害了弗里曼夫妇，绑架了这两名十几岁的女孩，

sentences.en: and set fire to the Freeman home.
sentences.zh: 并放火烧毁了弗里曼的家。

sentences.en: Information is also filed with the affidavit, revealing the girls were kept alive for an unknown number of days following the fire.
sentences.zh: 宣誓书还附带了相关信息，显示女孩们在火灾发生后还存活了若干天。

sentences.en: The Polaroid photographs of the girls in their final days were seen by multiple people, and Welch, Pennington,
sentences.zh: 有多人曾看到过女孩们生命最后几天的宝丽来照片，而韦尔奇、彭宁顿

sentences.en: and Busick made many statements to multiple people about the crimes during their lives.
sentences.zh: 和布西克生前曾向多人多次谈及这些犯罪行为。

sentences.en: Although the criminal case against Mr. Busick has commenced, we must stay focused on the recovery of Ashley and Laura for the sake of the families and our entire community.
sentences.zh: 尽管针对布西克先生的刑事诉讼已经开始，为了家属和我们整个社区的利益，我们必须把重点放在找回阿什利和劳拉上。

sentences.en: The following is from an article on Fox23.com.
sentences.zh: 以下内容摘自 Fox23.com 的一篇文章。

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 引述：

sentences.en: According to Fox23.com, the affidavit allegedly goes on to say that Welch, Pennington, and Busick had implied to others,
sentences.zh: 据 Fox23.com 报道，宣誓书据称还指出，韦尔奇、彭宁顿和布西克曾暗示他人，

sentences.en: that the Freeman parents had been murdered over a debt, and that Laura and Ashley had entered a room where the Freeman parents were buying drugs on the night of the crime.
sentences.zh: 弗里曼夫妇是因为债务问题而被谋杀的，案发当晚劳拉和阿什利走进了弗里曼夫妇购买毒品的房间。

sentences.en: The suspects had threatened the lives of people who may have had information about the crimes, which is why they didn't come forward over the years.
sentences.zh: 嫌疑人曾威胁过那些可能掌握案情信息的人的生命，这就是为什么他们多年来一直没有站出来。

sentences.en: Investigators don't know how long the girls were kept alive after they were kidnapped.
sentences.zh: 调查人员不知道女孩们被绑架后活了多久。

sentences.en: Investigators still need people to come forward with information about where the girls' bodies may be.
sentences.zh: 调查人员仍然需要知情人提供关于女孩们遗体可能藏在哪里的信息。

sentences.en: Anyone with information is urged to contact the Oklahoma State Bureau of Investigation at 1-800-522-8017.
sentences.zh: 任何有线索的人请立即拨打 1-800-522-8017 联系俄克拉荷马州调查局。

sentences.en: Or via email at the following address, tips at osbi.ok.gov.
sentences.zh: 或通过以下电子邮箱地址提供线索：tips@osbi.ok.gov。

sentences.en: A private reward of $50,000 still stands for information regarding the location of the girls.
sentences.zh: 对于提供女孩下落信息的线索，目前仍悬赏 50,000 美元私人奖金。

sentences.en: I do feel like the investigators are saying there are people out there over this process that are afraid to talk because they're fearful for their life.
sentences.zh: 我的确觉得调查人员在说，在这个过程中有一些人因为害怕危及生命而不敢开口。

sentences.en: You know, they can remain anonymous.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，他们可以保持匿名。

sentences.en: They can make calls and talk and say, we really think you need to do this.
sentences.zh: 他们可以打电话交谈，说，我们真的觉得你们应该这么做。

sentences.en: Or back when, 2015, I took a different approach to trying to find my daughter, and I started using the online media, which really sparked where we are today in three years.
sentences.zh: 或者在 2015 年的时候，我采取了另一种寻找女儿的方法，我开始使用网络媒体，这真正点燃了我们在三年里走到今天的契机。

sentences.en: Because it wasn't the older generation, it was their children and grandchildren that says, I might know something.
sentences.zh: 因为站出来的不是老一辈，而是他们的孩子和孙辈，他们说，我可能知道些什么。

sentences.en: And it's due to their efforts coming out that we're able to move forward.
sentences.zh: 正因为他们站出来的努力，我们才得以继续前进。

sentences.en: But there are people out there, I still feel in my heart, that they know something.
sentences.zh: 但我内心仍然觉得，外面还有人知道些什么。

sentences.en: However little it might be to them, it's like a puzzle piece.
sentences.zh: 对他们来说可能微不足道，但这就像是一块拼图。

sentences.en: But somebody knows where these girls are.
sentences.zh: 可是有人知道这些女孩在哪里。

sentences.en: And for me, I need to bring my daughter home.
sentences.zh: 对我而言，我需要把我的女儿带回家。

sentences.en: I want to just say to our greatest and deepest thanks to Gary Stansel and Mrs. Farrar for their work and involvement in this case.
sentences.zh: 我只想对加里·斯坦西尔和法拉利女士在此案中的工作和投入表示最崇高和最深切的感谢。

sentences.en: Because it was a wild mess before they became involved through all these years.
sentences.zh: 因为在他们介入之前的这些年里，情况简直是一团糟。

sentences.en: And the first 15 years seemed like it was fruitless.
sentences.zh: 而且前 15 年看起来似乎毫无成效。

sentences.en: Very little bit of information and evidence ever came forward.
sentences.zh: 几乎没有什么信息和证据浮出水面。

sentences.en: But through the last three years, the Lord has answered a lot of prayers for us.
sentences.zh: 但在过去的三年里，上帝回应了我们许多的祈祷。

sentences.en: And we just want to thank the law enforcement community.
sentences.zh: 我们只想感谢执法界。

sentences.en: Not just the DA's office and the OSBI, but Craig County Sheriff's Department, all the sheriff's departments and law enforcement agencies that we've dealt with through the years.
sentences.zh: 不仅是地方检察官办公室和俄克拉荷马州调查局，还有克雷格县警长办公室，以及这些年来我们打过交道的所有警长办公室和执法机构。

sentences.en: And Kansas, too.
sentences.zh: 还有堪萨斯州。

sentences.en: And around the area, all the different areas.
sentences.zh: 还有周边地区，所有不同的地区。

sentences.en: I know I'm probably forgetting someone, but I just want to thank them all for their participation and help in this case.
sentences.zh: 我知道我可能漏掉了什么人，但我只想感谢他们所有人对本案的参与和帮助。

sentences.en: We've missed her for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们已经想念她很久了。

sentences.en: But we're going to bring her home.
sentences.zh: 但我们要把她带回家。

sentences.en: And we're going to hold on to that.
sentences.zh: 我们要坚持这个信念。

sentences.en: Thank you all very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。

sentences.en: Thank you all very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢大家。
